revisions.body: The older accusations matter because they reach the jury before the courtroom does. Socrates says many listeners encountered this story in childhood, when they were especially ready to believe it: that he was a wise man who investigated things in the sky and beneath the earth and made the weaker argument stronger. Most of these accusers cannot be summoned or questioned. One way to read his first task, then, is as an attempt to unsettle the inherited picture the jury brings to the present indictment.

He also says that most of these accusers cannot be summoned or questioned.
